# 4image

> Image-first viewer for 4chan boards and threads. A thread opens as a grid of its images, with an optional text mode for reading the posts. All content belongs to 4chan and its posters; 4image keeps only a short-lived cache.

## Pages

- `/` lists every board
- `/{board}` is the board catalog, for example `/v`
- `/{board}/{thread}` opens a thread over its catalog, for example `/v/750676141`

## For agents

- To read boards and threads, use the official 4chan API instead of these pages: `https://a.4cdn.org/boards.json`, `https://a.4cdn.org/{board}/catalog.json`, `https://a.4cdn.org/{board}/thread/{no}.json`. Docs: https://github.com/4chan/4chan-API
- Make at most one request per second, and refresh a thread no more than once every 10 seconds.
- `/api/` and `/img/` on this site are short-lived caches of 4chan data and files for the 4image interface, not a public API. Please do not crawl them.
- The original images and videos live on `https://i.4cdn.org/{board}/{file}`. Link there rather than re-hosting them.
- Threads expire, so links to them stop working after a while.
- Many boards are not safe for work. `ws_board` in `boards.json` says which are.

## Source

- https://github.com/blackkriger/4image
